''See also: [[Candle Bay Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Candle Bay is a coastal location characterized by its busy harbor, which serves as a hub for merchants, fishermen, and navigators. The bay is directly connected to the [[Aion Sea]], a dangerous body of [[water]] inhabited by various monsters and phantoms. Within this bay, the [[Blackwatch]] have attempted to summon [[Elderspawn]]. The area also features a Playhouse that performs seasonal theatrical productions. Historically, the location was home to the [[Candle Bay Imperial Prison]], a facility described as a place of torture that had been reduced to rubble before its recent reopening. The bay's waters are noted for being dark green, and the surrounding environment includes a shore where debris from destroyed structures can be found.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Candle Bay is a harbor that serves as a location directly connected to the [[Aion Sea]]. The waters of this area present a danger where ships could potentially sink, and the bay remains visible from the window of [[Rojric]]'s cell. During his time there, [[Calder]] jumped into the bay and used the location to abandon contingency tools.}}
